`sites` is a bundled Consuelo OS skill. Operates Consuelo site-delivery infrastructure: launcher pages, typed pages, traces, diffs, settings surfaces, and static/edge delivery materialization.

## When to use it

Invoke when the user asks about OS site delivery, local site materialization, launcher pages, typed page registries, traces, diffs, settings pages, or edge snapshot routing.

Typical requests include:

- “Inspect the local Sites delivery state.”
- “Refresh and verify the static page delivery surface.”

## Enable it

```bash
consuelo add skill sites
```

Run `consuelo add skill` without a name to choose from the skills that are not currently selected. Remove it with:

```bash
consuelo remove skill sites
```

## What the agent loads

The installed metadata points to `skills/sites/SKILL.md` in the immutable OS runtime. The compact steering catalog advertises the active skill by name and description; the full `SKILL.md` body is loaded only when the workflow applies.

Metadata for this skill currently declares permission `guidance` and `requiresApproval: no`. Those fields describe the skill contract; individual tools called by the skill still enforce their own authorization and safety rules.

## Boundary

Sites is delivery infrastructure. Artifacts owns durable generated outputs and their product-level catalog/history.

## Verify

After enabling it, confirm `~/Consuelo/Skills/sites/SKILL.md` exists and that `sites` appears in `<CONSUELO_HOME>/components/installed-skills.json`. A newly bootstrapped agent should then see `sites` in the Installed skills portion of steering.
